hebrewText: שְׁמַ֤ע אֵלַ/י֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְקֹרָאִ֑/י אֲנִי הוּא֙ אֲנִ֣י רִאשׁ֔וֹן אַ֖ף אֲנִ֥י אַחֲרֽוֹן

tokens.bdb: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] attentively, call (gather) together, [idiom] carefully, [idiom] certainly, consent, consider, be content, declare, [idiom] diligently, discern, give ear, (cause to, let, make to) hear(-ken, tell), [idiom] indeed, listen, make (a) noise, (be) obedient, obey, perceive, (make a) proclaim(-ation), publish, regard, report, shew (forth), (make a) sound, [idiom] surely, tell, understand, whosoever (heareth), witness.
tokens.enLiteralWord: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention
tokens.explanation: shama — ouvir, escutar, obedecer, prestar atenção
tokens.explanationEn: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a
Yaaqov — Jacó (depois chamado Israel), patriarca das 12 tribos

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
tokens.explanation: Yisrael — nome dado a Jacó (aquele que luta com Deus)

tokens.bdb: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: bewray (self), that are bidden, call (for, forth, self, upon), cry (unto), (be) famous, guest, invite, mention, (give) name, preach, (make) proclaim(-ation), pronounce, publish, read, renowned, say.
tokens.explanation: qara — chamar, nomear, convocar, proclamar, invocar

tokens.kjv: I, (as for) me, mine, myself, we, [idiom] which, [idiom] who.

tokens.bdb: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.enLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanation: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanationEn: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self

tokens.bdb: first, in place, time or rank (as adjective or noun)
tokens.kjv: ancestor, (that were) before(-time), beginning, eldest, first, fore(-father) (-most), former (thing), of old time, past.

tokens.bdb: meaning accession (used as an adverb or conjunction); also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.kjv: also, [phrase] although, and (furthermore, yet), but, even, [phrase] how much less (more, rather than), moreover, with, yea.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though
tokens.enLiteralWord: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though

tokens.explanationEn: meaning accession ; also or yea; adversatively though

tokens.bdb: hinder; generally, late or last; specifically (as facing the east) western
tokens.kjv: after (-ward), to come, following, hind(-er, -ermost, -most), last, latter, rereward, ut(ter) most.
